title: ThreadPoolExecutor Patterns — Companion Code
description: Runnable ThreadPoolExecutor examples: map vs submit/as_completed, per-future error handling, thread-safe result collection, and thread-local sessions. Smoke test uses sleep-based tasks, no network needed.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de ThreadPoolExecutor: map vs submit/as_completed, manejo de errores por future, recoleccion thread-safe de resultados y sessions thread-local. El smoke test usa tareas con sleep, sin red.
